fact: The Banque Centrale des Comores says it is operator, supervisor and participant of KomorPay (ATS), the national interbank payment system operational since 23 April 2026.

Mayotte Hebdo reports KomorPay, the Banque centrale des Comores' national interbank payment infrastructure for processing, clearing and settlement in central bank money, has been operational since 23 April 2026, cutting cheque and transfer processing from three days to one working day.

Al-Watwan reports the Banque Centrale des Comores introduced and launched Komor Switch, a national platform connecting all banks and mobile money services for interoperability, and KomorPay, an automated interbank transfer system.

The Banque Centrale des Comores' financial inclusion strategy says its regulation sets the licensing conditions for e-money issuers and that payment service providers' transactions are authorised by the BCC.
